Retain backend-supplied previous-page recovery for empty later Search pages
Use locally loaded Devanagari font fallbacks and a trusted per-response shell language
Place viewport metadata in Next Head in _app and respect reduced-motion preference

Add visible archive heading hierarchy and neutral headings for unlabeled populated Home selections
Suppress empty optional regions in private previews while retaining private robots behavior
Reject malformed optional UI fields/media variants before reaching React renderers
Render deterministic UTC dates to avoid host/browser timezone hydration differences
Validate social destinations through the shared link helper and retain accessible platform labels
